name: Duplicati
title: Duplicati: free Acronis alternative
caption:
Acronis True Image charges $49.99/year to back up your computer. Duplicati does it for free 💾

✅ Backs up the folders you pick, on a schedule that runs by itself
✅ Sends backups to Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, an external drive and more
✅ Encrypts everything with AES-256 before it leaves your computer
✅ After the first backup, only changes are saved, so it's fast and small

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ You bring your own storage (an external drive or a cloud account you already have); Duplicati also sells an optional paid storage and console service. Acronis's $49.99/year is its Essentials plan

dm_pitch: Duplicati, the free open-source Acronis alternative 💾

beats.say: Acronis: fifty bucks a year. This: zero.
Your laptop dies tomorrow. Then what?
Acronis True Image charges fifty a year. Duplicati costs nothing.
Pick the folders you care about, like your documents and photos.
Then it sends them to an external drive, or cloud storage you already have, like Google Drive.
Everything is encrypted before it leaves your computer, and it runs on its own schedule.
It's Acronis, minus the subscription, forever.
